chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: We, the Ahl al-Bayt, are the tree of Prophethood, the place of the Message, the place frequented by the angels, the house of mercy, and the معدن of knowledge.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household, referring to the sacred family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.بَيْتُ الرَّحْمَةِ: the house characterized by divine mercy
key_terms.شَجَرَةُ النُّبُوَّةِ: the root and living source of Prophethood
key_terms.مَعْدِنُ الْعِلْمِ: the source and repository of knowledge
key_terms.مَوْضِعُ الرِّسَالَةِ: the locus where the divine message is placed
key_terms.مُخْتَلَفُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ: the place where angels come and go repeatedly

ai.seo_question: How does al-Kafi describe the status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the tree of Prophethood and the mine of knowledge?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the exalted station of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as the locus of Prophethood, divine message, angelic descent, mercy, and knowledge. It presents their rank as central to understanding religious authority, sacred knowledge, and the continuity of divine guidance after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from his father, from Abdullah Al Mugheira, from Ismail Bin Abu Ziyad, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Weasws, the Peopleasws of the Household, are the tree of Prophet-hood, and a receptacle of the Message, and the inter-change of Angels (where Angels come and go), and the House of Mercy, and the Mine of Knowledge’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Adallah ibn Muhammad ibn ’Isa from his father from ‘Adallah ibn al-Mughirah from Isma‘il ibn abu Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) from his father (a.s.) from Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) who has said the following.

“We, the Ahl al-Bayt (family of the Holy Prophet), are the tree of the prophet-hood, the station of the Messenger-ship of (Allah), the center wherein the angels interchange, the house of blessings and the mine of knowledge.”
